property_tests.description: For any combination of --user, --org, and --workspace flags on secrets/vars create, API calls are always made in fixed user→org→workspace order regardless of flag order on the command line.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Enumerate all 7 non-empty subsets of {user, org, workspace} flags; for each subset, run 'afc secrets create KEY=val' with those flags in random order on the command line; record the sequence of DoRequest paths
property_tests.invariant_check: For each run: if user scope is included, its DoRequest call appears before org scope calls; if org scope is included, its DoRequest call appears before workspace scope calls; the sequence of paths matches the expected user→org→workspace subsequence for the given flag subset

property_tests.description: For any multi-scope create where at least one scope fails, the command always exits 1 and all remaining scopes are still attempted after the failure.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: For each of the 6 possible (scope-set, failing-scope) combinations where scope-set has 2+ scopes and failing-scope is in scope-set: run 'afc secrets create KEY=val' with those flags; mock the failing scope to return 500 and all others to return 200
property_tests.invariant_check: exitCode == 1; server.requestCount == len(scope-set) (all scopes attempted); stdout contains responses from all successful scopes; stderr contains the error envelope for the failing scope

property_tests.description: For any invocation of afc secrets delete or afc vars delete that receives a 204 response, CLIPrintResult is never called and stdout remains empty.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: For each of the 3 scope selectors (user, org, workspace) and both commands (secrets delete, vars delete): run the delete command with a mock server returning 204; capture stdout and the list of CLIPrintResult calls
property_tests.invariant_check: stdout == '' for all 6 combinations; CLIPrintResult call count == 0; stderr contains the confirmation message matching the exact format "Secret/Variable 'KEY' has been deleted.\n"

property_tests.description: For any command invocation where the positional argument fails parsing, no HTTP request is ever made to the server.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate invalid argument strings: (a) strings with no '=' character, (b) comma-separated strings with empty tokens, (c) whitespace-only keys; apply each to all create and update subcommands (secrets create, secrets update, vars create, vars update)
property_tests.invariant_check: server.requestCount == 0 for every invalid-argument invocation; exitCode == 2 for every case; stderr is non-empty

property_tests.description: For any invocation of list, update, or delete commands with two or more ownership selectors, the command exits 2 without making any API call.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Enumerate all multi-selector combinations (user+org, user+workspace, org+workspace, user+org+workspace) for each of the 6 single-scope commands (secrets list, secrets update, secrets delete, vars list, vars update, vars delete); run each combination
property_tests.invariant_check: exitCode == 2 for all 24 combinations; server.requestCount == 0 for all combinations; stderr contains a message about single scope requirement

property_tests.description: For any command invocation with no ownership flags provided, the API call path always begins with /api/v1/user/ confirming user scope is selected by runtime zero-value detection.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Run each of the 8 subcommands (secrets create, secrets list, secrets update, secrets delete, vars create, vars list, vars update, vars delete) with no ownership flags; record the DoRequest path for each
property_tests.invariant_check: For all 8 invocations: server.lastRequest.path starts with '/api/v1/user/'; exitCode == 0 (given a 200/204 mock response)

property_tests.description: For any non-DELETE command that receives a successful API response, CLIPrintResult is called with the exact value returned by DoRequest without reshaping.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: For each non-DELETE subcommand (secrets create, secrets list, secrets update, vars create, vars list, vars update, vars resolve): mock DoRequest to return a sentinel response object with a unique marker field; capture what CLIPrintResult receives
property_tests.invariant_check: The value passed to CLIPrintResult is reference-equal or deep-equal to the value returned by DoRequest; no fields are added, removed, or renamed; the sentinel marker field is present in the CLIPrintResult argument
